name: gy-cross-border
description: Guyana cross-border income tax for 2026 under the Income Tax Act, Cap. 81:01 and the Corporation Tax Act, Cap. 81:03 (GRA consolidations revised 1 April 2026) and Guyana's tax treaties. Covers withholding tax at 20% on distributions and on interest, rent, royalties, management charges, personal services, commissions and fees paid to non-residents not trading in Guyana (ITA s. 39, 40, Third Schedule), 20% on branch profits deemed remitted, 10% on payments to non-resident contractors (CTA s. 10B), payment by the 14th or within 30 days, the rule that the payer withholds 20% unless the Commissioner-General accepts a treaty rate, treaty rates under the CARICOM agreement and the Canada, United Kingdom and United Arab Emirates treaties, the connected non-resident and group apportionment rules (ITA s. 49), the 1% head office expense cap, foreign tax credit and unilateral relief (ITA s. 89, 90, Fourth Schedule) and penalties. Trigger on: Guyana withholding tax non-resident, Guyana treaty rate,
